headline: Approved consent agenda, director's report, and budget appropriations and transfers for Electric, Water, and Sewer Divisions
summary: The Public Utilities Commission approved consent agenda items, the June 2026 Director's Report with corrected demand figures, and budget appropriations and transfers for the Electric, Water, and Sewer Divisions. Commissioners also discussed the I-91 Pump Station Replacement Project tour and water drainage and inflow and infiltration issues, with no action taken on those topics.
decisions: Approved the Consent Agenda, including Special Meeting Minutes of June 23, 2026, Special Meeting Minutes of June 30, 2026, and a Budget Amendment for the Water Division FY 2025/2026 Power Purchased for Pumping (Account #43100623), 3 ayes.
Approved the Director's Report for the Month of June 2026, with corrections noting a decrease (not increase) of 9.10% in peak demand, 3 ayes.
Approved a Budget Appropriation for the Electric Division of $14,000.00 from Retained Earnings to Account 598 - Distribution Maintenance - Misc. Distribution/Environmental, 3 ayes.
Approved a Budget Transfer for the Water Division FY 2025/2026 of $299,475.00 from various accounts, funded by transfers from Account #43100642 ($150,000) and Account #43100673 ($149,475), 3 ayes.
Approved a Budget Transfer for the Sewer Division FY 2025/2026 of $63,550.00 from various accounts, funded by a transfer from Account #46100665 ($63,550), 3 ayes.
